discovery_notes: WDW 2023 open-edition pass; 24 WebSearch calls (shared search budget exhausted before planned ~35), all search_snippet. Mostly Disney Pins Blog and WDWNT. 2023 dated series spotted Dec 2022 but included as 2023 merchandise. Many pins sold at both Disneyland and WDW. EPCOT festival pins in 2023 appear LE/LR only. Possible duplicates kept separate: Figment lightbulb vs 'Dreamfinding Since 1983'; Star Wars Jul booster vs Oct Mandalorian/Clone Trooper set; HM Coffin vs Let Me Out. Price conflict kept for RnRC guitar (12.99 vs 11.99). OE silver tier rose 11.99->12.99 Oct 2023 per DPB. June DPB week attribution for Turning Red/Randall inferred from spotted date. Not covered (budget): TRON, Galaxy's Edge, Toy Story Land, Disney Springs, resort OE, Festival of the Holidays.
